purpose: Present a compact keyboard key or shortcut label using the shared control geometry.
useWhen: a shortcut or keyboard affordance needs a visible label
avoidWhen: a primary action needs a full Button contract
accessibility: Uses the native kbd element so assistive technology receives shortcut semantics.
Keeps the visible label supplementary to the control that owns the action.
responsive: Keeps shortcut labels compact and allows the surrounding layout to wrap.
Uses shared caption typography and control spacing across density modes.
motion: Has no required motion; surrounding interactive states use shared transition tokens.
Respects prefers-reduced-motion through the global component contract.

api.name: className
api.description: Additional class hook for recipe-level layout composition.
